about: Golden questions for the agent. Each has the semantic query a correct answer uses and an independent hand-written reference SQL over the raw tables (no LookML). Free tests (pytest) check that the compiler matches the reference; live tests (pytest -m live) send the question to the agent through Gemini. Relative dates assume today = 2026-10-26.

questions.question: How much did I spend in September 2026?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature IN ('tier1_operational_cost','tier2_capital_outlay') THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature = 'tier2_refund_offset' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) FROM master_records WHERE STRFTIME(CAST(date AS DATE), '%Y-%m') = '2026-09'

questions.question: What was my income in September 2026?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature IN ('tier1_operating_income','tier2_capital_inflow') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) FROM master_records WHERE STRFTIME(CAST(date AS DATE), '%Y-%m') = '2026-09'

questions.question: What was my savings rate in September 2026?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature IN ('tier1_operating_income','tier2_capital_inflow') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - (SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature IN ('tier1_operational_cost','tier2_capital_outlay') THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature = 'tier2_refund_offset' THEN amount ELSE 0 END))) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature IN ('tier1_operating_income','tier2_capital_inflow') THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100 FROM master_records WHERE STRFTIME(CAST(date AS DATE), '%Y-%m') = '2026-09'

questions.question: How much did I spend last month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature IN ('tier1_operational_cost','tier2_capital_outlay') THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature = 'tier2_refund_offset' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) FROM master_records WHERE STRFTIME(CAST(date AS DATE), '%Y-%m') = '2026-09'

questions.question: How much have I spent this month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature IN ('tier1_operational_cost','tier2_capital_outlay') THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature = 'tier2_refund_offset' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) FROM master_records WHERE CAST(date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-26'

questions.question: How much have I spent this year?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature IN ('tier1_operational_cost','tier2_capital_outlay') THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature = 'tier2_refund_offset' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) FROM master_records WHERE YEAR(CAST(date AS DATE)) = 2026

questions.question: What is my savings rate this year?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature IN ('tier1_operating_income','tier2_capital_inflow') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - (SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature IN ('tier1_operational_cost','tier2_capital_outlay') THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature = 'tier2_refund_offset' THEN amount ELSE 0 END))) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature IN ('tier1_operating_income','tier2_capital_inflow') THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100 FROM master_records WHERE YEAR(CAST(date AS DATE)) = 2026

questions.question: What was my Tier 1 (living) spend in October 2026?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(ABS(amount)) FROM master_records WHERE NOT is_transfer AND nature = 'tier1_operational_cost' AND STRFTIME(CAST(date AS DATE), '%Y-%m') = '2026-10'

questions.question: What is my Tier 1 operating savings rate this year?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature='tier1_operating_income' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature='tier1_operational_cost' THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature='tier1_operating_income' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100 FROM master_records WHERE YEAR(CAST(date AS DATE)) = 2026

questions.question: What did I spend by category group in September 2026?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT c.category_group, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT t.is_transfer AND t.nature IN ('tier1_operational_cost','tier2_capital_outlay') THEN ABS(t.amount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN NOT t.is_transfer AND t.nature = 'tier2_refund_offset' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM master_records t LEFT JOIN dim_categories c ON t.category_id = c.category_id WHERE STRFTIME(CAST(t.date AS DATE), '%Y-%m') = '2026-09' GROUP BY 1

questions.question: How much have I spent on Travel Transport?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN NOT t.is_transfer AND t.nature IN ('tier1_operational_cost','tier2_capital_outlay') THEN ABS(t.amount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN NOT t.is_transfer AND t.nature = 'tier2_refund_offset' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM master_records t JOIN dim_categories c ON t.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = 'Travel Transport'

questions.question: How much did the Eurotrip26 trip cost?

questions.question: How much did I spend under the label 'Gastos, Entretenimiento y Viajes'?

questions.question: How much have I spent on transactions that carry any label?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature IN ('tier1_operational_cost','tier2_capital_outlay') THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature = 'tier2_refund_offset' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) FROM master_records WHERE id IN (SELECT b.transaction_id FROM bridge_transaction_labels b JOIN dim_labels l ON b.label_id = l.label_id)

questions.question: How much did I spend per label?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT l.label_name, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT t.is_transfer AND t.nature IN ('tier1_operational_cost','tier2_capital_outlay') THEN ABS(t.amount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN NOT t.is_transfer AND t.nature = 'tier2_refund_offset' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM bridge_transaction_labels b JOIN master_records t ON b.transaction_id = t.id JOIN dim_labels l ON b.label_id = l.label_id GROUP BY 1

questions.question: Which categories were over budget in October 2026?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT category_name FROM mart_category_budget WHERE year_month = '2026-10' AND budget_status = 'Exceeded' GROUP BY 1

questions.question: How many times did a category go over budget this year?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mart_category_budget WHERE year_month LIKE '2026-%' AND budget_status = 'Exceeded'

questions.question: How did restaurants spend compare with its budget in October 2026?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(net_spent), SUM(recommended_budget_cap) FROM mart_category_budget WHERE year_month = '2026-10' AND category_name = 'Restaurants & fast food'

questions.question: Show my spend per month this year.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT STRFTIME(CAST(date AS DATE), '%Y-%m'), SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature IN ('tier1_operational_cost','tier2_capital_outlay') THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature = 'tier2_refund_offset' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) FROM master_records WHERE YEAR(CAST(date AS DATE)) = 2026 GROUP BY 1

questions.question: How much did I spend in Q3 2026?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature IN ('tier1_operational_cost','tier2_capital_outlay') THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature = 'tier2_refund_offset' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) FROM master_records WHERE CAST(date AS DATE) >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND CAST(date AS DATE) < DATE '2026-10-01'

questions.question: Compare my spend in August and September 2026.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT STRFTIME(CAST(date AS DATE), '%Y-%m'), SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature IN ('tier1_operational_cost','tier2_capital_outlay') THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature = 'tier2_refund_offset' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) FROM master_records WHERE STRFTIME(CAST(date AS DATE), '%Y-%m') IN ('2026-08','2026-09') GROUP BY 1

questions.question: How was last month's spend compared with the same month last year?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT STRFTIME(CAST(date AS DATE), '%Y-%m'), SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature IN ('tier1_operational_cost','tier2_capital_outlay') THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature = 'tier2_refund_offset' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) FROM master_records WHERE STRFTIME(CAST(date AS DATE), '%Y-%m') IN ('2026-09','2025-09') GROUP BY 1

questions.question: Who were my top 5 merchants by spend in September 2026?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT merchant, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature IN ('tier1_operational_cost','tier2_capital_outlay') THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature = 'tier2_refund_offset' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS s FROM master_records WHERE STRFTIME(CAST(date AS DATE), '%Y-%m') = '2026-09' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY s DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 5

questions.question: How many expenses did I have in September 2026?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM master_records WHERE NOT is_transfer AND type = 'expense' AND nature IN ('tier1_operational_cost','tier2_capital_outlay') AND STRFTIME(CAST(date AS DATE), '%Y-%m') = '2026-09'

questions.question: What is my average expense ticket this year?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT AVG(ABS(amount)) FROM master_records WHERE NOT is_transfer AND type = 'expense' AND nature IN ('tier1_operational_cost','tier2_capital_outlay') AND YEAR(CAST(date AS DATE)) = 2026

questions.question: How much did I get back in refunds this year?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM master_records WHERE NOT is_transfer AND nature = 'tier2_refund_offset' AND YEAR(CAST(date AS DATE)) = 2026

questions.question: What is the total balance of my active accounts?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(current_balance_cop) FROM dim_accounts WHERE is_active

questions.question: How much did I spend in transactions paid in euros?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature IN ('tier1_operational_cost','tier2_capital_outlay') THEN ABS(amount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN NOT is_transfer AND nature = 'tier2_refund_offset' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) FROM master_records WHERE currency = 'EUR'

questions.question: Which category's spend grew the most from August to September 2026?
questions.reference_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT c.category_name, STRFTIME(CAST(t.date AS DATE), '%Y-%m') AS ym, SUM(CASE WHEN t.nature = 'tier2_refund_offset' THEN -t.amount ELSE ABS(t.amount) END) AS v FROM master_records t LEFT JOIN dim_categories c ON t.category_id = c.category_id WHERE NOT t.is_transfer AND t.nature IN ('tier1_operational_cost','tier2_capital_outlay','tier2_refund_offset') AND NOT (t.nature = 'tier2_refund_offset' AND COALESCE(c.category_group, '') = 'Income') GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT COALESCE(sep.category_name, aug.category_name), COALESCE(sep.v, 0) - COALESCE(aug.v, 0) AS d FROM (SELECT * FROM s WHERE ym = '2026-09') sep FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM s WHERE ym = '2026-08') aug ON sep.category_name = aug.category_name WHERE aug.category_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d DESC LIMIT 1
